<<NOTES ON WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL>>

WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL IS A COMMON WAY TO PREPARE A WALL FOR A NEW OR REPAIRED WALL. IT HELPERS TO MAKE THE WALL LOOK CLEAN AND NEW. THE PROCESS INCLUSES APPLYING A THIN LAYER OF WHITEWASH OVER THE WALL SURFACE. THIS HELPERS TO PREVENT FROST FROM DAMAGE THE WALL. WHITEWASHING IS ALSO USED TO MAKE THE WALL MORE TOLERANT TO THE ELEMENTS. IT IS IMPORTANT TO USE A QUALITY WHITEWASH THAT IS RESISTANT TO MOISTURE AND WEATHER. THE WALL SHOULD BE CLEANED AND DRY BEFORE APPLYING THE WHITEWASH. IT IS BEST TO DO THIS IN THE SPRING OR SUMMER WHEN THE WEATHER IS COLD AND DRY. AFTER APPLYING THE WHITEWASH, THE WALL SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO DRY COMPLETELY. IT IS IMPORTANT TO CHECK THE WALL REGULARLY TO MAKE SURE THE WHITEWASH IS NOT PEELING OR FLAKING. WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL CAN HELP TO PREVENT FROST FROM DAMAGE THE WALL AND TO MAKE IT LOOK BETTER. THIS IS A SIMPLE AND COST-Effective WAY TO MAINTAIN A CELLAR WALL.
